name: Kivotos Mykonos
positioning: Cycladic-style hotel of suites and villas on a rocky hillside above its own private beach on Ornos Bay, Mykonos
best_for: Couples looking for a suite with sea views and a private pool or outdoor jetted tub
Travelers who want a private beach reserved for hotel guests

facts.text: Kivotos Mykonos sits at the far end of a wind-protected private beach reserved for hotel guests.
The hotel's cove has views over Ornos Bay.
The suites and villas follow classic Cycladic design and step down a rocky hillside toward the hotel's private beach.
The private beach is a curve of white sand right below the lower-level pool.
The main saltwater pool is on the lower level, just above the private beach.
The main pool area has underwater music, a Jacuzzi and a swim-up bar.
The Two Bedroom Suite with Pool combines two interconnecting suites, each with its own queen bedroom, living room and bathroom.
An a la carte Mediterranean restaurant sits on a shaded patio by the pool, overlooking Ornos Bay.
The hotel's spa is ONAR Spa.

highlights.text: The Signature Suite 130 has a private pool with a front made entirely of glass.
Guests can arrange a private meal, an intimate gathering or a small cocktail party by the beach, in a separate private area or on the hotel's yacht.
The Honeymoon Suite has sea views and an open-air jetted tub.
The beach below the hotel is private and reserved for hotel guests.

considerations.text: The suites and villas are spread down a rocky hillside toward the beach.
WhataHotel notes limited on-site facilities due to the hotel's boutique size.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
